sentence-shapes.title: Sentence Shapes
sentence-shapes.objective: I can spot what makes a sentence just right!

blend-builders.title: Blend Builders
blend-builders.objective: I can blend sounds into whole words, even words with tricky blends!

sound-spotters.title: Sound Spotters
sound-spotters.objective: I can find the first, middle vowel, and last sounds in words, even words with blends!

ask-it-find-it.title: Ask It, Find It
ask-it-find-it.objective: I can ask a question about a story and find the answer in its words.

story-message.title: Story Message
story-message.objective: I can retell a story in order and find its central message.

fact-questions.title: Fact Questions
fact-questions.objective: I can ask and answer questions about facts in a book.

sound-stretchers.title: Sound Stretchers
sound-stretchers.objective: I can stretch a word and say every sound in order!

smooth-reader.title: Smooth Reader
smooth-reader.objective: I can read a story out loud with a good pace and expression.

check-and-fix.title: Check and Fix
check-and-fix.objective: I can stop, check, and fix a word that does not make sense.

story-parts.title: Story Parts
story-parts.objective: I can describe a story's characters, setting, and major events using key details.

word-pictures.title: Word Pictures
word-pictures.objective: I can find words in poems and stories that appeal to the senses or show feelings.

fact-links.title: Fact Links
fact-links.objective: I can tell how two facts in a book link together.

digraph-detectives.title: Digraph Detectives
digraph-detectives.objective: I can read words with two-letter teams like the ones in ship, chat, thin, and whale!

sound-it-out.title: Sound It Out
sound-it-out.objective: I can read a brand new word by saying each sound in order and blending them together!

magic-teams.title: Magic Teams
magic-teams.objective: Silent e and vowel teams make a vowel say its name.

two-kinds-of-books.title: Two Kinds of Books
two-kinds-of-books.objective: I can explain how books that tell stories and books that give information are different.

whos-telling-it.title: Who's Telling It
whos-telling-it.objective: I can find out who is telling the story at each part.

decoding-champions.title: Decoding Champions
decoding-champions.objective: I can pick the right phonics tool and use it to decode long words.

long-or-short.title: Long or Short?
long-or-short.objective: I can hear and see whether a vowel is long or short and read look-alike words correctly.

team-players.title: Team Players
team-players.objective: I can read words with the vowel teams oo, ow, oi, oy, and aw, even when a team makes two different sounds.

fable-tellers.title: Fable Tellers
fable-tellers.objective: I can read a whole fable, retell it in order, and find the moral it teaches.

character-challenges.title: Character Challenges
character-challenges.objective: I can describe how a character responds to major events and challenges in a story.

paragraph-power.title: Paragraph Power
paragraph-power.objective: I can find the main topic of a whole text and the job of each of its paragraphs.

word-music.title: Word Music
word-music.objective: I can describe how words and phrases give a poem rhythm and meaning.

story-shape.title: Story Shape
story-shape.objective: I can describe how a story's beginning introduces it and its ending concludes the action.

two-ways-to-see.title: Two Ways to See It
two-ways-to-see.objective: I can notice when two characters feel differently about the same thing and tell who feels what.
